decision.qualificationToOriginalAdoptionRule: The NF-e cursor candidate allocated 33,208 B/document in one fork versus 32,408 in the other three and all four controls. That higher mode also occurred in an unmodified control in the prior probe experiment. Adoption accepts this residual allocation uncertainty rather than claiming that the original allocation guard was fully satisfied; the current experiment does not establish allocation neutrality or diagnose the frequency of this mode.
decision.rationale: A large repeatable benefit for ordinary LocalDate parsing, a small stateless implementation with preserved semantics, no new observed allocation level, and throughput guard point estimates inside the predeclared limit. The qualification remains visible for PR review; no merge or release.
